newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - PNB recommended trading buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PNB recommended trading buy.

text.p: Philippine National Bank was recommended a trading buy on Wednesday by Sun Hung Kai Securities after the bank said it extended loans to the buyers of its major assets.
"By extending to the buyers, the bank will be able to subsequently earn interest income from the one-time gains which effectively had been used as loans," the brokerage house said.
"However, it also exposes the bank to the risk of potential default. The buyers' paying capacity remains to be seen," it said.
PNB generated loans of 3.5 billion pesos from the buyers of its 8,000 sq metre property in the financial district of Makati, and its wholly-owned real estate unit, Sun Hung Kai said.
The Makati property fetched 3.68 billion pesos and the real estate unit 505.62 million pesos.
It estimated the extraordinary gains from these two transactions amounted to 4.14 billion pesos.
